LiteLLM is the world’s most popular open-source AI Gateway, used by Adobe, Netflix, NASA, NVIDIA and much of the Fortune 500. Every LLM call these companies make runs through our code, so when we break, they break. We’re a team of about 20, and we’re hiring senior and staff backend engineers to own the core of the gateway and keep it fast and reliable as traffic grows.

About the role

You’ll own critical parts of the LiteLLM proxy: routing, auth, caching, spend tracking, guardrails and observability.
